headlines.title: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for almost $13 billion, expanding further up AI stack
headlines.summary: This is the kind of deal that moves the whole tape — Nvidia stepping up the AI stack from chips into the model hub and developer ecosystem is a genuine strategic shift, not just a headline. It rattles every AI software name from Hugging Face competitors to cloud providers, and it tells you Jensen Huang isn't done swinging. Watch NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL, and anything touching the open-source AI layer.

headlines.title: Iran strikes Kuwait as Trump says renewed Mideast hostilities will not last 'too long'
headlines.summary: Iran expanding strikes to Kuwait is a genuine escalation — the Strait of Hormuz is already a choke point and now a neighboring Gulf state is in the crossfire, which means oil supply risk just got a zip code. This hits energy prices, shipping stocks, airline costs, and bond yields all at once, and Lloyd's is already counting a £1.4 billion loss. The whole risk complex is repricing around this one.

headlines.title: Broadcom's stock drops 5% as weak guidance overshadows earnings beat
headlines.summary: Broadcom is a bellwether for the entire AI semiconductor food chain — when its guidance disappoints, the whole sector gets a cold. A 5% drop on a beat-and-miss-guidance combo is the market telling you expectations are priced for perfection, and that's a warning shot for every chip name on the board. Keep an eye on how AVGO's weakness bleeds into MRVL, QCOM, and the SOX index.
